 -- IM:5412; AV; 05/08/2011

 if is_timezone_enabled then

 else

 end if; 
 exception

 tackle_error('TimeZone Convert');
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 -- 
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;

 select distinct ord.customer_id, name,
 --bx.insert_date, -- Commented by Kishore on 05/04/2012. IM 8585
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, bx.insert_date), -- Added by Kishore on 05/04/2012. IM 8585

 :creation_date,

 from boxes bx, pick_slip_products psp,
 orders ord, customers cus,pick_slips ps
 where bx.box_id = :box_id and
 bx.box_status = 'OP' and
 bx.box_id = psp.box_id and
 ps.order_no = ord.order_no and
 bx.shipment_no is null and

 ('CL','CA','SY','HO','PE','SH') and
 ord.customer_id = cus.customer_id and
 ord.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 bx.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 bx.warehouse_id = :GLOBAL.warehouse and
 cus.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 ps.pick_slip_id like 'PA%' and
 ps.pick_slip_id = psp.pick_slip_id and
 psp.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 ps.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 product_status != 'CA' and
 product_type in ('RPL','RPFF');
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0334');
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 message
 ('Too many rows found in v_order_to_shipments for this box id', NO_ACKNOWLEDGE); -- IM 562
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in checking from v_orders_to_shipments - 10', NO_ACKNOWLEDGE); -- IM 562
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select distinct product_type
 into :ctrl_blk_1.product_type
 from pick_slip_products
 where pick_slip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.pick_slip_id and
 pick_slip_products.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 product_status != 'CA';
 exception

 then

 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 -- calculate total number of units
 --
 begin
 select box_type, capacity
 into :GLOBAL.box_type, :GLOBAL.capacity
 from vserv_box_capacity
 where product_type = :ctrl_blk_1.product_type and
 chp_sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1);
 exception

 then
 message('More than one box type defined for product', NO_ACKNOWLEDGE); -- IM 562
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in finding box capacity', NO_ACKNOWLEDGE); -- IM 562
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select count(unit_id)
 into :s_number_of_products
 from pick_slip_products
 where pick_slip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.pick_slip_id and
 pick_slip_products.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 product_status in ('PK','RP');
 if :s_number_of_products >= to_number(:GLOBAL.capacity)
 then
 show_error_dist('3202');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in calculating number of products', NO_ACKNOWLEDGE); -- IM 562
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 -- display current volume in box
 --
 begin
 select nvl(sum(component_weight/specific_gravity),0)
 into :s_previous_volume
 from components, pick_slip_products, valid_products
 where pick_slip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.pick_slip_id 
 and pick_slip_products.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id 
 and product_status in ('PK','RP','DL') 
 and pick_slip_products.unit_id = components.unit_id 
 and pick_slip_products.coll_date = components.coll_date 
 and pick_slip_products.chapter_id = components.chapter_id 
 and pick_slip_products.product_code = components.product_code 
 and pick_slip_products.aliquot = components.component_prefix 
 and pick_slip_products.product_status != 'CA'
 and valid_products.product_code = substr(components.product_code, 1, 5); -- Added by Kishore on 03/26/2013. SCR 19829
 --and valid_products.product_code = components.product_code; -- Commented by Kishore on 03/26/2013. SCR 19829
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 message('Error in calculating volumes', NO_ACKNOWLEDGE); -- IM 562
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :s_total_volume := :s_previous_volume;
end;

declare

 temp_life_span number(6,2);
 temp_scan_len number(1);
 temp_product_code varchar2(8);
 nPkdCnt NUMBER:=0;
 szUnitID VARCHAR2(15);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
---
--- modified for both the schemes to coexists
---
 select count(*),max(coll_date) into temp_count,:coll_date
 from active_products
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 if :global.checkin_required='Y' then
 show_error_dist('0312');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 begin
 select max(coll_date),count(*) into :coll_date,temp_count
 from components
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and
 ((system_label_decision = '49' AND :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'C') OR
 (system_label_decision = 'Mf' AND :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I')) and
 nvl(expiry_date,sysdate+1) > sysdate and
 component_status = 'L' and reject_reason_code is null
 and substr(product_code,1,5) in (select product_code from valid_products 
 where inv_product_type=:ctrl_blk_1.product_type);
 if temp_count = 0 then
 show_error_dist('0312');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 end if;
 end if;
 begin
---
--- modified for both the schemes to coexists
---
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from active_products
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 ((blood_type = '49' AND :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'C') OR
 (blood_type = 'Mf' AND :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I')) and
 exp_date > sysdate and
 stock_state = 'AV';
 exception

 then
 if :global.checkin_required = 'N' then
 begin
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from components
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and

 (system_label_decision = 'Mf' AND :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I')) and

 component_status = 'L' and reject_reason_code is null
 and substr(product_code,1,5) in (select product_code from valid_products 
 where inv_product_type=:ctrl_blk_1.product_type);
 exception when no_data_found then
 show_error_dist('3307');
 check_package_failure;
 when too_many_rows then null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 show_error_dist('3307');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 --Added for 3.2.0
